notes: Cover 'Name of Office' reads 'Cache County Clerk/Auditor' — agrees with the chunk file's 'Clerk/Auditor'. Candidate 'Jill N. Zollinger'; the chunk file's candidate string is 'Zollinger camp', which is a filename artefact ('..._Zollinger_Oct_28_14_camp_finance') and not what the form says — the form's name is authoritative. The report is addressed 'TO Jill N. Zollinger, County Clerk' — the candidate IS the incumbent county clerk, so she is both filer and addressee; that is not an error. The single contribution is the candidate self-funding her own filing fee, and the single expenditure is that filing fee paid to the Cache County Clerk — the two are the same 429.00 on the same day, 3/14/14. Cover signature date is 10/03/14; the chunk file records the filing as 2014-10-28 — noted, not resolved here (the clerk stamp is vertical and its day digits are not legible at any resolution tried). Cover line 3 LAST REPORT carries a scan speck over the leading dash so it images as 'Q0-'; the cell is '-0-' like the other eleven cells on the cover. Zero glyphs '-0-' are read as 0 per the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling, with the verbatim glyph kept here. The candidate's street address and both phone numbers on the cover, and the contributor's street address on Form A, were discarded at read time. This filing is machine-typed throughout — no handwriting, no bistable glyphs.
